actions.label: Browser portal
actions.description: Geeky folds into a browser window, peeks through, then springs back out. Use for opening a workspace.

actions.label: Project blueprint
actions.description: Unfolds a project plan, traces its circuit, and checks the first milestone. Use for GuateGeeks maker planning.

actions.label: Debug & repair
actions.description: Finds a broken circuit, pulls out the bug, and reconnects the trace. Use for fixing a coding exercise.

actions.label: Gentle reboot
actions.description: Ducks into a power ring, restores three system lights, then bounces back ready. Use for restarting a sandbox.

actions.label: Peek at the code
actions.description: Peeks over a code editor, scans a few lines, then slides the panel aside. Use for reviewing a learner’s project.

actions.label: Compile whirlwind
actions.description: Sweeps loose code cards into a miniature compiler, then presents a working chip. Use for building a project.

actions.label: Connect the stack
actions.description: Geeky uncoils two cable leads, joins their plugs and confirms a live technology connection.

actions.label: Route the network
actions.description: A balanced network mobile sends packets between connected nodes while Geeky follows their route.

actions.label: Focus mode
actions.description: Geeky settles into a coding session with headphones, a gentle rhythm and code-shaped audio bars.

actions.label: Build a maker project
actions.description: Geeky lifts a spring stack into a base, circuit layer and processor, assembling a GuateGeeks maker project.

actions.label: Compress the archive
actions.description: Geeky presses a stack of project files into a zipped archive, then releases it with a soft spring rebound.

actions.label: Deploy the code
actions.description: Geeky folds a code sheet into a paper plane, winds up and launches a verified deployment packet.

actions.label: GuateGeeks certificate
actions.description: Geeky unrolls a certificate and stamps its seal to celebrate a completed GuateGeeks technology course.

actions.label: GuateGeeks mentor
actions.description: Geeky reads a GuateGeeks lesson card, points through its three coding steps and checks the learner’s progress.
